answer: The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The horizon assignment is published and spiral records each panel. Shards are assigned from the haven graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3149 identities would post 849 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
